timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1550 KRW/USD (recently breached)

WHY: The won is currently weak (high KRW per USD), making dollars expensive right now. Multiple analysts forecast the won will strengthen significantly over the next 3 months, with Citi predicting rates falling to 1500 KRW/USD and some forecasts opening the door to 1600 KRW/USD possibilities—meaning you would get more won per dollar if you wait.

TIP: Consider delaying or staggering your July conversion if possible, since waiting 2–3 months could substantially reduce your KRW cost per $2,000 as the won strengthens.
